metadata.title: Free Immersions in Critical Dimension from Lie Groups
metadata.abstract: We construct free immersions of $P^3 \times S^1$ and $S^3 \times S^1$ into $14$-space. These are the first examples of free immersions in critical dimension of closed manifolds that are not spheres, projective spaces, tori, or surfaces. The idea is to mimic De Leo's construction for $m$-tori with $m \leq 5$. De Leo constructs a map that is symmetric with respect to a representation of the Lie group formed by the $(m - 1)$-torus; we replace this group with $\mathrm{SO}(3)$. In our examples, the osculating determinant is constant.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 构造 P³×S¹ 与 S³×S¹ 到十四维空间的自由浸入，以 SO(3) 代替环面群实现对称构造。
analysis.breakthrough: 扩展临界维已知闭流形实例，且密切行列式恒定。
analysis.limitations: 是浸入存在，不自动保证全局嵌入；P³ 的具体约定应依原文。 本条依据官方摘要整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立全文核查为准。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 GPT 5.6 Sol 的符号代数计算帮助简化第 3 节的 Ansatz；同时声明正文没有由 AI 生成的部分。
